scientific_name: 2026/27 EPL MW3 Prospective PIT Availability and XI Shadow
objective: Create immutable timestamped pre-kickoff availability evidence for all ten EPL MW3 fixtures without reading target results or target confirmed XI. This stage validates prospective data provenance and preserves inputs for a later separately governed XI/1X2 confirmation; it makes no promotion claim.

collection_protocol.first_snapshot: one governed run immediately after this contract and implementation are frozen, before the earliest MW3 kickoff
collection_protocol.repeat_rule: A later snapshot is admissible only for fixtures whose kickoff is still strictly in the future at source observation time. No target fixture may be sampled at or after kickoff.
collection_protocol.raw_source_bytes: seal in the run Artifact with SHA256 and observation/retrieval timestamps
collection_protocol.fixture_binding: all 20 frozen team short codes must bind exactly to the FPL team surface
collection_protocol.future_fixture_filter: the collector must stop if the first governed snapshot begins at or after the earliest frozen kickoff
collection_protocol.label_policy: no result, score, confirmed XI or postmatch target data may be fetched or persisted in this stage

next_if_snapshot_pass: Keep the Artifact immutable. Do not inspect target results. Before confirmed-XI reveal, separately freeze the XI reconstruction/availability-adjustment receipt format. Confirmed XI may later be used only as the lineup evaluation label; match results require a separate later reveal gate.
next_if_snapshot_stop: Repair engineering or source-binding defects only if no target kickoff has occurred and without changing scientific source semantics; otherwise stop MW3 and move to the next untouched future matchweek.
